meta.title: Bakvion — Automatic, encrypted backups for Windows
meta.description: Bakvion backs up your business files every day to your own external disk or Google Drive. Set up in about 2 minutes.

hero.lead: Bakvion backs up your business files every day — to your own external disk or your Google Drive. Set it up once in about 2 minutes, then forget about it.

steps.title: Ready in about 2 minutes
steps.subtitle: No technical knowledge needed. Three steps and your files are safe.
steps.s1Text: Download Bakvion and run the installer. It sets everything up for you.
steps.s2Text: Sign in with the details you received, or tap “Connect with Bakvion experts” and we'll set you up.
steps.s3Text: Pick your folders, pick your disk or Google Drive, and choose when to back up. Done.

features.title: Everything a small business needs
features.f1Text: Runs on your schedule in the background, even when the app is closed.
features.f2Text: Every backup is locked with strong encryption before it is saved.
features.f3Text: Get back any file or folder from any day, in a few clicks.
features.f4Text: Know after every backup whether it worked — or what to fix.

where.title: Your backups stay with you
where.subtitle: Bakvion saves your files only to places you own. We never see or store your data.

install.title: Installing: one quick note
install.subtitle: Windows may show a blue “Windows protected your PC” screen the first time. This is normal for new software.
install.step3: Follow the installer — it takes under a minute
install.shotBody: Microsoft Defender SmartScreen prevented an unrecognized app from starting.

expert.title: Talk to a Bakvion expert
expert.subtitle: Tell us a little about your business. We'll call or WhatsApp you within 24 hours and set everything up.
expert.name: Your name
expert.thanksBody: A Bakvion expert will contact you within 24 hours.
expert.errOffline: No internet. Connect and try again.
expert.errRate: Too many requests. Please try again later.
expert.errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: How do I get an account?
faq.a1: Fill in “Talk to a Bakvion expert” here or in the app. We create your account and send you your sign-in details on WhatsApp.
faq.a2: Yes. Backups keep running offline. Bakvion syncs your membership whenever you're back online.
faq.q3: What happens if my membership ends?
faq.a3: New backups pause, but you can always restore everything you already backed up.

final.title: Protect your files today
final.subtitle: Download Bakvion, open it, and you're a few clicks away from automatic backups.
